answer: Force every new identity to enter through a copper-priced trust ticket sold by an existing established sponsor, who locks its own bond as collateral against the newcomer's behavior. Sponsors may issue only a handful of tickets per epoch, so a sable-cloaked ring of clones quickly exhausts every sponsor willing to risk capital on strangers. Raven patrols — random spot-checks — freeze a sponsor's bond when its sponsored identities move in lockstep, so an attacker must fund one full bond-backed ticket per clone while honest newcomers enter cheaply through people who actually trust them.
